note: Montezuma (the site simulator; technolog-spectrumai/montezuma): it draws each robot from the machine's visual mesh (the CAD design, the root link's visual 'cad') and reads the machine's mass and provenance; the drones (quad, drako) fly on their rigid body and rotor dynamics through Yax's MJCF writer: inertia, the free joint and the propulsion block (00prop: rotors, propeller maps, motors, reduced kF/kM/w_max/tau; boreas, nb08 and assumed say where each number comes from); the ground robots keep its own speeds and turning. A Yax requirements file of tag codes: python tools/export.py <machine> --to out/<machine>.yx2 --consumer tools/consumers/montezuma.json (Montezuma takes them from exports/, published by tools/publish.py: its scripts/update_designs.sh)
